notes_for_editor: Only catalogue listings were found: no build date, builder, staffing, fate or site description. The gfc-112 code appears only in the tnlandforms catalogue (the brief's 'GFC US 112' repeats it); a Georgia Forestry Commission record would confirm it. Elevation column is unlabelled; feet fits the brief's 113.1 m. Wikipedia's community coordinates are about 0.8 km from the catalogued tower point, so the tower point may be approximate. Hold until a GFC or Emanuel County record is checked.
